item.title: Author Post
item.content:encoded:
The newest piece of Ad Astra Per Aspera canon — and yes, we are indeed still working on the hub. It is growing. It's a very big hub be patient :(

More AAPA: SCP-3417, DIRECTIVE A-42 and the series it starts, FTL Prelude

My main concern was that this would be confusing or uninteresting without AAPA context. Thank you to 9Volt, WrongJohnSilver, LordStonefish, and Varaxous for helping me to address those issues and/or giving feedback.
